## Category 1: UI Layout (6 tests)

### UAT-1.1: Compact horizontal layout
**Given:** User navigates to `/p/:slug` for a verified profile
**Then:** Profile card displays in horizontal layout with avatar on left, name/role on right
**Verify:** Playwright MCP screenshot — card should be ~150px height max, not full viewport

### UAT-1.2: Avatar size reduced to 64px
**Given:** Profile card is displayed
**Then:** Avatar is 64px (not 96px as before)
**Verify:** Playwright MCP screenshot or browser inspector

### UAT-1.3: Share button visible and functional
**Given:** Profile card is displayed
**When:** User clicks share button
**Then:** Profile URL is copied to clipboard and toast confirmation appears
**Verify:** Playwright MCP click share button, check for toast message

### UAT-1.4: Blue ring shows for pledgers
**Given:** Profile belongs to a user who has pledged
**Then:** Blue ring is visible around avatar
**Verify:** Playwright MCP screenshot on pledger profile vs non-pledger profile

### UAT-1.5: Room for future content below card
**Given:** Profile card is displayed
**Then:** Card is positioned at top of content area, with empty space below for future features
**Verify:** Playwright MCP full-page screenshot — card should NOT be vertically centered

### UAT-1.6: Responsive on mobile
**Given:** Profile page viewed on mobile viewport (375px width)
**Then:** Card displays properly without horizontal overflow
**Verify:** Playwright MCP resize to 375px, take screenshot

---

## Category 2: User States (4 tests)

### UAT-2.1: Owner (pledger) sees "View My Pledge" button
**Given:** Logged-in user views their own profile AND has pledged
**Then:** "View My Pledge" button is displayed
**When:** User clicks button
**Then:** Navigates to `/p/:slug/pledge`
**Verify:** Playwright MCP login as pledger, navigate to own profile, verify button and click

### UAT-2.2: Owner (non-pledger) sees "Take the Pledge" CTA
**Given:** Logged-in user views their own profile AND has NOT pledged
**Then:** "Take the Pledge" button is displayed
**When:** User clicks button
**Then:** Navigates to `/sign-pledge?prefill=true`
**Verify:** Playwright MCP login as non-pledger, navigate to own profile, verify button and click

### UAT-2.3: Visitor (viewing pledger) sees "View their pledge" link
**Given:** User views another user's profile who has pledged
**Then:** "View their pledge →" link is displayed with blue ring on avatar
**When:** User clicks link
**Then:** Navigates to `/p/:slug/pledge`
**Verify:** Playwright MCP navigate to pledger profile (not logged in or as different user)

### UAT-2.4: Visitor (viewing non-pledger) sees no pledge section
**Given:** User views another user's profile who has NOT pledged
**Then:** No pledge CTA or link is displayed, no blue ring on avatar
**Verify:** Playwright MCP navigate to non-pledger profile

---

## Category 3: Accessibility (1 test)

### UAT-3.1: Share button has accessible label
**Given:** Profile card is displayed
**Then:** Share button has `aria-label="Share profile"` or visible text
**Verify:** Playwright MCP snapshot (a11y tree) or browser inspector

---

## Category 4: Unchanged Behaviors (1 test)

### UAT-4.1: Unverified owner still sees verification prompt
**Given:** User is logged in but email not verified
**When:** User navigates to `/me` or their profile
**Then:** Full-page verification prompt is displayed (NOT compact card)
**Verify:** This existing behavior must NOT change — Playwright MCP with unverified user
